component.name: animaEngine
component.summary: Animated character overlay for your Linux desktop
Suprapunere cu personaje animate pentru desktop-ul tău Linux

description.p: animaEngine renders multiple animated characters or sprites on top of your desktop using transparent, always-on-top windows with GPU acceleration. It's written in Rust with wgpu and winit — no Electron, no Chromium, minimal RAM footprint.

ul.li: Click-through by default — your desktop stays fully usable
Drag-and-drop PNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG, or H.264 MP4 files to add characters
Per-entity behaviors: walk-around, follow-cursor, bounded-wander
System tray icon and global hotkeys (Ctrl+Shift+A/H/P)
Hot-reload of the TOML config — edit live
Native X11 (XShape click-through) and experimental wlr-layer-shell paths

description.p: Faza C — engine polish. Ten sub-phases across multi-monitor, multi-window data, asset library, behavior expansion, animation curves, and sprite groups.

ul.li: Multi-monitor distribution modes (PerMonitor / Span / Single-by-name) with per-entity pin and Ctrl+M cycle hotkey.
Multi-window data layer — WindowConfig with backwards-compat migration.
Asset library — directory scan, persistent index, search-filter UI, drag-drop validation preserved on every "Add to scene".
Bounce behavior (Horizontal / Vertical / Both axes) with rest-position locking and drag invalidation.
Six easing curves on the per-frame timing pipeline; GIF/WebP delays remain authoritative.
Sprite groups (data + visibility composition); a hidden group hides every member, click hit-test honours it.
Hand-tuned performance baseline ships under examples/perf_baseline.rs.

description.p: Patch release fixing a startup crash on systems without libxkbcommon-x11 preinstalled. Affects AppImage on minimal containers and fresh .deb installs.

ul.li: Bundle libxkbcommon-x11 explicitly in the AppImage (linuxdeploy can't discover dlopen'd libraries on its own).
Add libxkbcommon-x11-0 to .deb depends.
Install libxkbcommon-x11-dev across all CI jobs so smoke tests pass on Xvfb runners.

description.p: UI/UX polish release. Twelve sub-phases focused on coherence, accessibility, and localisation.

ul.li: Four themes: Dark, Light, Dark · High contrast, Light · High contrast (WCAG AAA).
Tabbed settings sidebar: Inspector, Scene, Appearance.
Six bundled scene presets — Append or Replace.
Ctrl+K command palette with fuzzy search over themes and presets.
Ten UI languages — English, Română, Español, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português (BR), Polski, Nederlands, 日本語.
AccessKit bridge for AT-SPI screen readers; keyboard reference table in Appearance.
New Ghost Mascot app icon.
